records.text: Owens said she released The Midas Touch, episode one of her Epstein Files series, July 16 in conjunction with Xavier Poussard’s reporting.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: On July 16th, I begin my Jeffrey Epstein series in conjunction with Xavier Pussard's reporting. Same person I did the Brigitte (Brigitte Macron) series with. ... It is also the same day that I dropped episode one of the series on Epstein (Jeffrey Epstein) Files called The Midas Touch, how they pulled him through the ranks is what the episode is about, how, you know, where did Epstein (Jeffrey Epstein)'s money come from?
